label: At D1, update gate is high after reaching S2, low after reward or a2-to-S1.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw z of unit 38 is large only at D1 (timing ~0.5-0.68) and near zero at GO/D2. Beyond timing, its D1 magnitude is set by the previous trial: reached S2 raises it (+0.34), previous reward lowers it (-0.18), and the rare a2->S1 transition lowers it further (-0.19); so a1 S2 u / a2 S2 u highest, a2 S1 r lowest. Belief, trial-before reward and future variables add almost nothing. The free fit adds a first-window-step (unknown previous trial) offset, a small extra drop for S1-rewarded, and a GO bump after a1 S2 r. GO/D2 variation is tiny.

issues: The claims hold up. The profile residual table at D1 runs from +0.34 (a1 S2 u) and +0.32 (a2 S2 u) down to -0.39 (a2 S1 r). Residuals at GO and D2 all lie within ±0.06, so 'only at D1' is right. The recorded short form scores 0.712 on test, which I reproduced, against a last-trial table score of 0.78 and an observed ceiling of 0.80.

The rare-transition term is the same as a prev_common term: replacing (prev_action==2)*(prev_state==1) with (prev_common==0)*(prev_state==1) gives exactly 0.712. So the 'a2-to-S1' wording is accurate.
Every term is needed. Dropping the third term gives 0.643, and swapping it for the first-step offset (prev_action==-1) gives 0.714.

Systematic misses from the short form are moderate, not large. The window's first step (D1 after '?') is under-predicted by +0.118, a start-of-window effect the free fit absorbs with prev_action==-1. D1 after a1 S1 r is over-predicted by -0.094, because the reward drop is bigger after S1 (about -0.24) than after S2 (about -0.13). Several worst-fit windows are runs of rewarded a1-S1 trials, where the actual value is about 0.2 against a predicted 0.39.

A slightly better alternative passes --short: (phase==D1)*(prev_state==2) ;; (phase==D1)*(prev_reward==1)*(prev_state==1) ;; (phase==D1)*(prev_action==2). It scores 0.737 on test. Its weights are +0.33, -0.27 and -0.14, so in this version reward only lowers the gate after S1, and choosing a2 lowers it overall. It trades errors rather than removing them: it misses D1 after a2 S2 u by +0.12 and a1 S2 r by -0.12, because it drops the reward effect after S2. The gain over the recorded form is small.
Belief adds nothing once the last trial is known. Replacing the third term with belief_lo gives 0.716, below the alternative's 0.737. No future variables are used.
skeptic.revised_label: At D1, z is high after reaching S2; lowered after rewarded S1 and after choosing a2.
